final: WITH matched AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId), counts AS (SELECT race_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY race_name), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT c.race_name, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.tot AS share FROM counts c CROSS JOIN total t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares) SELECT s.race_name, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS share_minus_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s
